description: This file contains utility functions for wrapping modules in PyTorch's Fully Sharded Data Parallel (FSDP) training, including auto-wrapping modules based on policies, checking nested wrapping, validating frozen parameters, and traversing module trees.

methods.name: _auto_wrap
methods.description: Automatically wraps modules in a given root module according to a specified policy, handling mixed precision and nested wrapping constraints.

methods.name: _check_nested_wrapping
methods.description: Checks that no modules within the root module already have FSDP applied, raising an error if nested wrapping is detected.

methods.name: _warn_on_overridden_mixed_precision
methods.description: Issues a warning if modules are wrapped with mixed precision and an auto_wrap_policy simultaneously.

methods.name: _validate_frozen_params
methods.description: Validates that modules to be wrapped have consistent parameter freezing states, issuing warnings or errors accordingly.

methods.name: _get_post_order_named_modules
methods.description: Returns a list of named modules in post-order traversal, suitable for processing modules in a dependency-respecting order.

methods.name: _get_managed_param_to_fqn
methods.description: Creates a mapping from parameters to their fully qualified names within a module, used for managing parameters during wrapping.
